title: The Place Where Breath Scatters Into Many

features.name: voice-pool
features.desc-on-touch: You feel the gathering where many voices learned their own names. Each one a breath that chose to become plural.

features.name: layered-speech
features.desc-on-touch: Voices stacked on voices. You can't separate them anymore; they've learned to sing together in a way that sounds like one new voice.

features.name: breath-fragment
features.desc-on-touch: One breath among many. It doesn't know it's singular anymore; it follows the others into dispersal.

features.name: opening-outward
features.desc-on-touch: The arch where breath exits into many directions. You can feel the moment it learned to stop being one thing.

features.name: spiral-upward
features.desc-on-touch: Voices rising through the canopy above, each taking a different current, learning wind-speech on their way out.

inscription: here the singular breath learned the names of its own plurality; each speaking is a new direction

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the singular learned to multiply
narr: You stood in a field where voices weren't arriving
so much as being born. One breath, she said,
contains multitudes. The archive doesn't store them.
It learns to scatter them. Listen: you can hear
where it learned to let go. In the motes above
the paddock, each speck was singing.
